note: Honoraruntergrenze figures from IG Freie Theaterarbeit, applicable to projects from 2025. Gross (Dienstgeber:innen-Brutto for employment, or fee before tax and SVS for self-employment). Verified 2026-08-25 at https://freietheater.at/honoraruntergrenze/ . Vienna's Kuratorium has weighed fee floors in its assessment since 2020, so budgeting below them can count against the application.
